conclusion.original: Some i<N has f(x_i)-f(z) <= (||x_0-z||^2+G^2 sum_{k<N}a_k^2)/(2 sum_{k<N}a_k). Raw source states the equivalent unnormalized finite-sInf inequality.

Conversely any such witness bounds m by its value, and multiplication by positive 2A recovers the source inequality.
